name: Elune's Tear
summary: On Ashenvale's central island, Elune's Tear offers night elf healers a sacred means to cleanse corruption and sickness.

sections.title: A Sacred Cleansing Stone
sections.body: Elune's Tear rests on a small islet in Iris Lake, east of Astranaar. Night elves believe the stone carries the Moon Goddess's purity. Corruption has turned the lake green, and twisted bog beasts roam its shores. Local herbalists and healers, including Orendil Broadleaf, seek the stone as an emergency remedy when ordinary woodland poultices cannot wash away deep corruption.

sections.title: A Desperate Remedy
sections.body: Relara Whitemoon, a young night elf in Astranaar, falls ill with a mysterious wasting sickness. Her father, Pelturas, exhausts ordinary medicines. At apothecary Orendil's counsel, Pelturas seeks Elune's Tear to brew into a restorative stew. The stone gives immediate hope against the strange malady, but Ashenvale's stubborn corruption often calls for greater rites of cleansing.

faq.answer: Elune's Tear is a rare magical mineral on an island in Iris Lake, Ashenvale. Night elves regard it as sacred to Elune and use it to cleanse unnatural corruption and deadly sickness.

faq.q: Where can Elune's Tear be found?
faq.answer: Elune's Tear lies on the island in the middle of Iris Lake, east of Astranaar in central Ashenvale. Follow the stream path north from the main road to reach it.

faq.q: Why does Pelturas Whitemoon need the tear?
faq.answer: Pelturas seeks Elune's Tear to help his ailing daughter, Relara. When ordinary herbal cures fail against her strange sickness, apothecary Orendil advises him to use the stone's restorative power.

faq.q: What guards the stone at Iris Lake?
faq.answer: Twisted bog beasts roam the shores of Iris Lake, whose waters have turned green under Ashenvale's spreading corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know relics bearing Elune's name as sacred gifts. The stone's use to save an innocent child reflects the kaldorei bond with the Moon Mother's healing grace.
As a priest, you recognize the stone's power to purge shadow and rot. Its healing reflects the restorative miracles attributed to the Priesthood of Elune.
